structuralFindings: ⚠ ROOM CATEGORY LINEUP CHANGED FROM 2026 — do not assume column letters map 1:1 across years. 2026 had 5 categories (A=Bustani Garden, B=Pool Side, C=Junior Suite, D=Sea View, E=6BR Oasis Villa). 2027 has 6 categories (A=Bahari, B=Junior Suite, C=Sea View, D=Two Bedroom Ocean View Suite [4 pax/unit], E=Four Bedroom Oasis Villa [8 pax/unit], F=Six Bedroom Oasis Villa [12 pax/unit]). 'Bustani Garden' and 'Pool Side' room names from 2026 do not appear in 2027's table at all — either renamed, discontinued, or restructured; not confirmed which. 'Bahari' is a new room name not seen in the 2026 document. Treat these as potentially different room inventories, not a simple year-over-year price update of the same rooms.
Base meal plan All Inclusive, same Premium All Inclusive upsell concept as 2026 ($75/pp/night, adults only, min 4 nights).

New multi-bedroom unit tiers this year: Two Bedroom Ocean View Suite (sleeps 4, per-unit) and Four Bedroom Oasis Villa (sleeps 8, per-unit), in addition to the returning Six Bedroom Oasis Villa (sleeps 12, per-unit) — three different per-unit (not per-person) categories this year vs. one in 2026.
7 named seasons by date range (same structure/numbering convention as 2026, one year forward).

Third adult (above 12yrs) reduction = 30%, applies 'in room A,B,C' only this year (explicitly scoped to the three standard rooms) — 2026's document did not explicitly scope this the same way, may be an added clarification rather than a policy change.
Children policy identical in structure to 2026 (free under 2, 1st child free, 2nd child 50%).

Extra bed cost differs by unit type this year: Two Bedroom Ocean View Suite extra bed = $80 USD, Oasis Villa extra bed = $65 USD (flat, same as 2026) — a new distinction not present in 2026's single Oasis Villa-only extra bed line.
Early Booking discount ladder (10%, same 4 windows/cutoffs shifted one year forward) and cancellation policy bands are structurally identical to 2026.
